speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
title: Take Upon Us His Name
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder James G. O. Fantone spoke about “Take Upon Us His Name”.

quotes.text: Later, in a quiet moment of reflection, a profound question and a familiar scripture came to my mind. The question: What’s in a name? And the scripture, from King Benjamin: “There shall be no other name given nor any other way nor means whereby salvation can come unto the children of men, only in and through the name of Christ, the Lord Omnipotent” (Mosiah 3:17).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Savior’s invitation is not merely for us to add His name to our name like a badge of religious affiliation. The Savior warned, “[Some] draw near to me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me” (Joseph Smith—History 1:19).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: His invitation is for us to take upon us His name. It is an invitation to become more like Him through covenant keeping. The resurrected Lord asked, “Have they not read the scriptures, which say ye must take upon you the name of Christ, which is my name?” (3 Nephi 27:5 ; see also Mosiah 5:8 ; 6:2).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I love the simple yet profound answer taught by the prophet Moroni. He recorded that none were baptized “save they took upon them the name of Christ, having a determination to serve him to the end” (Moroni 6:3 ; see also Mosiah 18:13).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Taking upon us His name requires a lifelong determination to serve Him. And King Benjamin provided the divine key: “When ye are in the service of your fellow beings ye are only in the service of your God” (Mosiah 2:17).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: During another season, it was the girls’ room that was occupied by someone else. When the Relief Society president in the ward spoke of a vulnerable family whose children desperately needed a safe place to stay, my parents, without hesitation, opened our doors, and some of the children indefinitely moved into our sisters’ room.
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Marion G. Romney taught this eternal truth: “Service is not something we endure on this earth so we can earn the right to live in the celestial kingdom. Service is the very fiber of which an exalted life in the celestial kingdom is made” (“ The Celestial Nature of Self-Reliance,” Liahona, Mar. 2009, 19).
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: A year later those exact same missionaries would sit in my office with glowing faces and say, “President, I am so happy! I love the people, and I love this work. But time is moving too fast—I don’t want this to end!”
quotes.speaker: Elder James G. O. Fantone
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

scriptures.text: And moreover, I say unto you, that there shall be no other name given nor any other way nor means whereby salvation can come unto the children of men, only in and through the name of Christ, the Lord Omnipotent.

I was answered that I must join none of them, for they were all wrong; and the Personage who addressed me said that all their creeds were an abomination in his sight; that those professors were all corrupt; that: "they draw near to me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me, they teach for doctrines the commandments of men, having a form of godliness, but they deny the power thereof."
Have they not read the scriptures, which say ye must take upon you the name of Christ, which is my name? For by this name shall ye be called at the last day;

And under this head ye are made free, and there is no other head whereby ye can be made free. There is no other name given whereby salvation cometh; therefore, I would that ye should take upon you the name of Christ, all you that have entered into the covenant with God that ye should be obedient unto the end of your lives.
And it came to pass that there was not one soul, except it were little children, but who had entered into the covenant and had taken upon them the name of Christ.
And none were received unto baptism save they took upon them the name of Christ, having a determination to serve him to the end.

And when he had said these words, the Spirit of the Lord was upon him, and he said: Helam, I baptize thee, having authority from the Almighty God, as a testimony that ye have entered into a covenant to serve him until you are dead as to the mortal body; and may the Spirit of the Lord be poured out upon you; and may he grant unto you eternal life, through the redemption of Christ, whom he has prepared from the foundation of the world.
And behold, I tell you these things that ye may learn wisdom; that ye may learn that when ye are in the service of your fellow beings ye are only in the service of your God.
And now behold, I ask of you, my brethren of the church, have ye spiritually been born of God? Have ye received his image in your countenances? Have ye experienced this mighty change in your hearts?
For how knoweth a man the master whom he has not served, and who is a stranger unto him, and is far from the thoughts and intents of his heart?
